title: Hollywood 10-Stage Virtual Production Framework
content: Production pipeline strictly enforces the 10-Stage Studio Engine: 01 ScriptBreak -> 02 Cork Board Structure -> 03 Master Canvas Plan -> 04 Blockout 3D Previs -> 05 Hyperframes Motion -> 06 Storyboard Studio -> 07 Slate Prompt -> 08 Circle Take Dailies (FFmpeg MP4) -> 09 Stem Studio Audio -> 10 DaVinci Resolve Conform.

title: The AI Content Foundry Cinematic Visual Identity
content: Visual signature: Dark tech-noir luxury studio grade with golden amber specular highlights (#F59E0B / #FBBF24), deep cosmic purple (#09041a / #140e2e), and anamorphic lens flares. All 3D soundstages render at 24.00 FPS DCI timing with 4K specular reflection maps.

title: Canonical Narrative Arc: A Fatherless Child
content: Master 15-Beat Save the Cat Structure locked: Devon Wells discovers his deceased father's unprocessed 16mm film reels. Themes: Generational reconciliation, identity, fatherly legacy, and spiritual resilience. Act 1 Setup leads to Midpoint Foundry Confrontation and Break into Three resolution.

title: Unreal Engine 5 Live Link Remote Control (:30010)
content: Permanent HTTP bridge to UE5 Remote Control Web Server at http://127.0.0.1:30010. Dispatches real-time CineCamera parameters (SetCurrentFocalLength 18-135mm, CurrentAperture f/1.4-f/8.0, Full Frame 36x24mm sensor gate, and 6-axis 3D dolly transforms) directly to /Game/Cinematics/CineCameraActor1.

title: ComfyUI Local Generative Node Bridge (:8188)
content: Direct socket/REST bridge to local ComfyUI instance at http://127.0.0.1:8188. Executes high-throughput FLUX.1 Dev, SDXL, and ControlNet depth workflows for continuity-locked storyboard slates, texture generation, and AI video animation takes.

title: Broadcast Audio Mastering & Open-Source Speech Engine
content: All project dialogue and sound stems comply with -24.0 LKFS / LUFS EBU R128 broadcast loudness standards. Open-source Kokoro-82M and Coqui XTTS-v2 generate character voice dialogue at 48.0 kHz 24-bit WAV. 5.1 Dolby Atmos submix matrix splits Dialogue (C), Foley (L/R), Music (Surround), and LFE Sub (<120Hz).

title: Multi-Episode TV Series & Seasons Engine
content: Supports full multi-season episodic television pipelines. Features Cold Open teaser generation, Act 1-5 structural breakdowns, A/B/C plotline tracking, character relationship matrices, and episodic cliffhanger pacing.

title: DaVinci Resolve & OpenMontage Conform Timeline
content: OpenMontage conform engine automatically compiles multi-shot dailies into industry-standard EDL (Edit Decision List) and Final Cut Pro XML sequences with ACEScc Rec.709 color profiling for instant roundtrip into DaVinci Resolve Studio and Adobe Premiere.

title: 16 Autonomous Department AI Agents Orchestration
content: Autonomous department crew (Executive Showrunner, Film Director, Virtual DP, Sound Designer, Editor, VFX Supervisor, Script Supervisor) executes live tool calling (save_beats, sync_ue5_camera, queue_comfy_generation, get_dcc_status, execute_stage_run) with persistent multi-session memory.

title: Native FFmpeg & Remotion Cinema Renderer
content: Native system FFmpeg integration renders real 4K and 1080p 24.000 FPS DCI MP4 video cards and dailies directly to /storage/ingested/. Video files are immediately streamable in the 4K Screening Room and distributed across social and theatrical platforms.
